name: SECURITY
gates: VERIFICATION GATE - Present-tense security, privacy, governance, resilience, compliance, deployment, or AI-control claims must match implemented and verified capability/status.
meta_description: Evaluate the controls protecting identity, authorization, data, integrations, AI-assisted actions, commercial activity, infrastructure, and operational.
title: Security Should Be Verifiable.
description: Evaluate the controls protecting identity, authorization, data, integrations, AI-assisted actions, commercial activity, infrastructure, and operational continuity. Verified status and scope stay visible beside material claims.

paragraphs.text: Evaluate the controls protecting identity, authorization, data, integrations, AI-assisted actions, commercial activity, infrastructure, and operational continuity. Verified status and scope stay visible beside material claims.

Review implemented controls for authentication, phishing-resistant MFA where supported, secure recovery, session protection, step-up authentication for sensitive actions, privileged access, and automated-abuse resistance.

Review server-side role, object-level, function-level, workspace, and tenant authorization controls designed to prevent unauthorized data access, BOLA/IDOR-style bypasses, privilege escalation, and cross-context leakage.
Testing, certifications, reports, penetration assessments, compliance statements, and reliability claims appear only when verified, current, attributable, and presented with their scope and status.

Review the current control register and supporting evidence for procurement or security review. Planned, beta, limited, or unverified controls are identified by status rather than presented as production facts.
